component.description: Dual-channel, 16-bit, 1.0-GSPS RF-sampling pipelined analog-to-digital converter (sub_type: rf_sampling). Buffered analog inputs with uniform input impedance to 1.2-GHz input bandwidth, on-chip dither, and an integrated wideband digital down-converter (DDC) block per channel. JESD204B subclass-1 serial output (2 lanes/ADC at 10.0 Gbps or 4 lanes/ADC at 5.0 Gbps) with multi-chip synchronization via SYSREF/SYNC. Noise floor -159 dBFS/Hz. Pinout (72-pin VQFNP): differential analog inputs INAP/INAM (ch A) and INBP/INBM (ch B); differential sampling clock CLKINP/CLKINM; external timing reference SYSREFP/SYSREFM and SYNC; common-mode output VCM (2.1 V, no external reference pin); JESD204B serdes lanes DA0-3P/M (ch A) and DB0-3P/M (ch B); SPI control SCLK/SDIN/SDOUT/SEN, RESET, PDN; supplies AVDD (1.9 V), AVDD3V (3.0 V), DVDD (1.9 V), IOVDD (1.15 V), and grounds AGND/DGND plus the back-side GND thermal pad.

pinout.name: INAP
pinout.description: Differential analog positive input, channel A.

pinout.name: INAM
pinout.description: Differential analog negative input, channel A.

pinout.name: INBP
pinout.description: Differential analog positive input, channel B.

pinout.name: INBM
pinout.description: Differential analog negative input, channel B.

pinout.name: CLKINP
pinout.description: Positive differential ADC sampling clock input; internal 100-ohm termination to CLKINM.

pinout.name: CLKINM
pinout.description: Negative differential ADC sampling clock input; internal 100-ohm termination to CLKINP.

pinout.name: SYSREFP
pinout.description: Positive external SYSREF input (JESD204B subclass 1). Connect to 1.8 V if unused.

pinout.name: SYSREFM
pinout.description: Negative external SYSREF input. Connect to GND if unused.

pinout.name: SYNC
pinout.description: Synchronization input for the JESD204B port.

pinout.name: VCM
pinout.description: Common-mode voltage output, 2.1 V; inputs internally biased to this pin through 600 ohm (effective).

pinout.name: DA0P
pinout.description: JESD204B serial data positive output, channel A lane 0 (DAxP lanes 0-3).

pinout.name: DA0M
pinout.description: JESD204B serial data negative output, channel A lane 0 (DAxM lanes 0-3).

pinout.name: DB0P
pinout.description: JESD204B serial data positive output, channel B lane 0 (DBxP lanes 0-3).

pinout.name: DB0M
pinout.description: JESD204B serial data negative output, channel B lane 0 (DBxM lanes 0-3).

pinout.name: SCLK
pinout.description: Serial (SPI) interface clock input.

pinout.name: SDIN
pinout.description: Serial (SPI) interface data input.

pinout.name: SDOUT
pinout.description: Serial (SPI) interface data output; can be configured as channel-B fast-overrange output.

pinout.name: SEN
pinout.description: Serial (SPI) interface enable.

pinout.name: RESET
pinout.description: Hardware reset, active high; internal 20-kohm pulldown.

pinout.name: PDN
pinout.description: Power down, active low; can be configured as channel-A fast-overrange output.

pinout.name: AVDD3V
pinout.description: Analog 3.0-V power supply for the analog buffer (pins 10,16,24,31,39,45).

pinout.name: DVDD
pinout.description: Digital 1.9-V power supply (pins 8,47).

pinout.name: IOVDD
pinout.description: Digital 1.15-V supply for the JESD204B transmitter (pins 4,51,57,64,70).

pinout.name: AGND
pinout.description: Analog ground (pins 18,23,26,29,32,36,37).

pinout.name: DGND
pinout.description: Digital ground (pins 3,52,60,67).

pinout.name: GND Pad
pinout.description: Exposed back-side ground / thermal pad; solder to the ground plane.
